description: Find a substring across the whole PDF. Returns each hit's page, offset within the page, and a snippet of surrounding text. Use for grep-style discovery before extracting full text.

contextChars.description: How many characters of surrounding text to include per hit (default 60).

maxHits.description: Cap the number of hits returned (default 200).

path.description: Absolute path to a PDF on the local filesystem.

name: search
title: Search PDF
